name: plausiden-crawler
description: Headless-browser audit: click through any web UI, capture console/network/CSP issues

scripts.audit:all: npm run audit && npm run audit:tablet && npm run audit:mobile
scripts.test:css-health-e2e: python3 fixtures/css-health/serve.py --port 8766 & sleep 2 && npx tsx src/cssHealthEndToEnd.ts; status=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; exit $status
scripts.install:deps: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
